name: Melia
body:
Melia
CR 1/2

This delicate woman has a greenish tinge to her skin and hair of a rich, deep red as autumn leaves.

XP 200
Melia druid 1
NG Medium fey
Init -1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 9, flat-footed 12 (+3 armor, -1 Dex)
hp 10 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref -1, Will +5
DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +2 (1d6+1)
Ranged sling -1 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks wooden fist 6 rounds/day (+1 damage)
Druid Spells Prepared (CL 1st; concentration +4)

1st—cure light wounds, entangleD (DC 14), shillelagh
0—detect poison, know direction, purify food and drink

Domain Plant

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 15
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 10
Feats EnduranceB, Weapon Focus (quarterstaff)
Skills Handle Animal +6, Heal +7, Knowledge (nature) +7, Knowledge (nobility) +28, Survival +9
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ nature bond (Plant domain), nature sense, wild empathy +3, woodland stride

ECOLOGY

Environment any forests
Organization solitary, pair, or grove (3-10)
Treasure NPC gear (quarterstaff, sling, wooden armor, other treasure)

Meliae are a kind of tree spirits, related to dryads. Maybe, like naiads, they could be the result of an intermingling of fey and mortal blood. Unlike dryads, meliae are not bonded to one specific tree and may travel as they deem fit but tend to prefer natural and wooden environments. All meliae are female; a melia who mates with a member of any other race has an equal chance to give birth to another melia or a child of her partner’s race.
